title: Iterated scan reaches its exit configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine, let $n$ be a natural number, let $c_j$ be configurations on a common input for natural numbers $j$, and let $d$ be a configuration on that input. Suppose that for every $j<n$, one step from $c_{j+1}$ gives $c_j$, and one step from $c_0$ gives $d$. Then for every $j\le n$, running $M$ from $c_j$ for $j+1$ steps gives $d$.
hypotheses_covered: M is a multi-tape Turing machine
The configurations c_j and d share a common input
For every j<n, one step from c_{j+1} gives c_j
One step from c_0 gives d
j is a natural number with j≤n
